name: Runtime Instrumentation & Debugging
description: Dynamic instrumentation and debugging of applications at runtime. Covers use of Frida, DynamoRIO, PIN, and debuggers (GDB, WinDbg, LLDB) for hooking, tracing, memory inspection, and behavioral analysis of applications during execution.

0.label: None
0.description: No exposure to runtime instrumentation or debugging

1.label: Awareness
1.description: Understands runtime instrumentation and debugging concepts
evidence: Can explain the difference between static and dynamic analysis
Familiar with debuggers (GDB, WinDbg) and instrumentation frameworks (Frida)
Understands breakpoints, memory inspection, and function hooking concepts

2.label: Guided Practice
2.description: Uses debuggers and basic Frida scripts under supervision
evidence: Set breakpoints, inspected memory, and stepped through code in a debugger
Ran pre-written Frida scripts to hook and trace function calls
Analyzed application behavior during execution in lab environments

3.label: Independent Practice
3.description: Independently instruments applications and writes custom hooks
evidence: Independently used runtime instrumentation on 5+ engagements
Writes custom Frida scripts for function hooking, argument logging, and return value modification
Uses debugger scripting (Python/GDB, WinDbg scripts) for automated analysis
Passed proficiency assessment on runtime instrumentation

4.label: Advanced / Mentor
4.description: Develops complex instrumentation; handles anti-debug; builds analysis frameworks
evidence: Develops DBI (dynamic binary instrumentation) tools with DynamoRIO or PIN
Builds reusable instrumentation scripts for common analysis tasks
Mentors junior analysts on instrumentation techniques

5.label: Expert / Authority
5.description: Authority on runtime analysis; develops novel instrumentation techniques
evidence: Published research on dynamic instrumentation or analysis techniques
Developed the lab's instrumentation toolkit and methodology
Creates custom DBI frameworks for specialized analysis needs
Trains teams on advanced runtime analysis

assessment_methods.description: Instrument a running application to extract encryption keys, trace API calls, and modify runtime behavior
Observe debugger and Frida usage for a live analysis task
